layers.title: Mars from orbit
layers.gridSpacing: 232 m in the source mosaic; about 2.6 km at the equator in our copy
layers.realDetail: About 2.6 km at the equator in our copy
layers.positionAccuracy: About 200 m, one pixel of the source mosaic (USGS product page)
layers.processing: Read as tiles from NASA Mars Trek at its zoom 4, redrawn on the Web Mercator square, and cut into tiles for zoom 0 to 5. Latitudes beyond 85.1 degrees are not kept.
caveats: The colour was added artistically by NASA Ames. It is not measured colour.
Brightness differences between regions were filtered out of the source mosaic to show landforms.
Imaged from 1976 to 1980. Dust cover and the polar caps have changed since.
Too coarse to show anything at walking scale. It is for finding sites, not for planning.
layers.credit: NASA Viking Orbiter; mosaic by USGS Astrogeology Science Center; colour by NASA Ames
